lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters are organized in a structured grid posterior to the gill slits, with a higher spatial frequency observed along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of diffuse higher-intensity pixels intersect with horizontal rows of primary blobs, forming distinct grid-like nodes across the visible mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge extends horizontally across the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with light-toned highlights on the dorsal aspect and localized shadowing on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette displays a sparse distribution of high-luminance nodes, primarily localized to the anterior and medial sections of the visible fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin exhibits a high-density constellation of micro-blobs, which are significantly smaller in diameter and more closely spaced than the primary lateral flank blobs.
